INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.

2. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates
